test_name: Key-signature octave per tonic: cnb:keysig-tonic-octave 'centred under the pitch-axis hook (session 24)
description: The Twinline geometry of the Configurator's fixture (12 pitch classes on 7 axis positions, octave stride 7, sps 2, lines -6 -3 -1 1 4 6, middle G = semitone 7 at position 0) with cnb:keysig-tonic-octave 'centred and twelve key signatures, tonics C to B. The Configurator's CNBKeySignature.tonicSemi rule centres each tonic's span [t, t+12] on the midpoint 7, ties going up: k = round((7 - 6 - pc) / 12), so C..G sit at t = 0..7 and G#, A, A# and B an octave lower, at t = -4..-1. With the separator bar shortened to 0.5 semitones a side, the harvested key-signature bbox is the marks' own, and its vertical centre is the centre of [hook(t), hook(t+12)]: (hook(t) + hook(t+12)) / 4 staff-spaces above the staff centre. Measured 2026-11-10 on 2.24 and 2.26: every signature within 0.006 of its expected centre. The spec also proves the session-24 fix of the key-signature stencil cache, which before it drew every signature after the first in a file with the first one's marks.

assertions._comment: === SECTION 1: TWELVE SIGNATURES, EACH ITS OWN KEY ===

assertions.description: Twelve key signatures are engraved, one per measure, on one system

assertions._comment: === SECTION 2: EACH TONIC'S OCTAVE IS THE CONFIGURATOR'S (CENTRED ON MIDDLE G) ===
